title: Old Seagrove Cottage Walk to Beach & Seaside
meta_description: Seagrove Sanctuary: 2BR/1BA cottage near Seaside with screened porch, boat parking, outdoor shower, beach gear, and coastal charm. Sleeps 6 on 30A.
description_expanded: AboutSeagrove Sanctuary – Walk to Beach and Seaside | Boat Parking | Old Seagrove Cottage Near 30A Looking for the perfect blend of Old Florida charm and modern comfort? Seagrove Sanctuary is a beautifully updated vacation rental in Old Seagrove Beach, located just steps from 30A, the beach, and the charming town of Seaside. This 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home sleeps 6 and offers plenty of parking, including room for a boat—a rare find along Scenic Highway 30A. Property Highlights: • Prime location in Old Seagrove – walk to the beach, Seaside, dining, and shopping • Close to 30A with easy access to top restaurants and boutiques • Boast-friendly vacation rental – space for a boat • Spacious wrap-around screened porch with swings and lounge seating • Fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter space • Dining area with large table and comfortable living room with flat-screen TV • Beach essentials included – 4 backpack beach chairs, umbrella, and beach wagon • Detached laundry room and outdoor shower • Quiet, shaded lot perfect for relaxing mornings and evenings • Plenty of parking for multiple vehicles • Amenity starter package including Starbucks coffee and bottled water Step into this updated 30A beach cottage and enjoy soaring ceilings, natural woodwork, and a spacious open-concept layout that brings the family together. The great room connects the fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and living space—making it the perfect hub for conversation and connection after a day at the beach. The two queen bedrooms offer comfortable accommodations, both with TVs, while a sleeper sofa in the living area allows for additional guests. A walk-in shower, updated finishes, and thoughtful coastal decor provide the perfect mix of vintage charm and modern ease. Outside, the wrap-around porch is where memories are made—sip coffee in a porch swing, listen to the sea breeze through the pines, or gather at sunset with drinks and laughter. The large sundeck is great for soaking up the rays, while the outdoor shower and laundry area make post-beach cleanup a breeze. Whether you’re here to relax, explore 30A, or bring along your boat, Seagrove Sanctuary offers a truly unique stay just moments from the heart of Seaside, Publix, local dining, and boutique shopping. Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 6): • Primary Bedroom: Queen Bed • Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed • Living Room: Sleeper Sofa Explore fishing charters, bike rentals, golf cart adventures, and some of the best seafood on the Gulf Coast—all within minutes of your front door. Book your stay at Seagrove Sanctuary and experience the charm, comfort, and convenience of this Seagrove Beach vacation rental near 30A.
